reproduction_findings.symptom: Authenticated student in Mission Realm could expand JEE Main and other missions, but both 'SMART START' and 'QUICK START' buttons were disabled / blurred, blocking access to Dashboard/Home.

root_cause_analysis.issue_1: In 48UI6, quickEntryEnabled, smartEntryEnabled, and missionSelectionReady were defaulted to false when omitted. isStartable required explicit true flags and allowed no exit path to Dashboard.
root_cause_analysis.issue_2: _buildMissionActionButtons checked recruitment.quickEntryEnabled directly instead of distinguishing mission shell access from academic diagnostic readiness.
root_cause_analysis.issue_3: Firestore document parsing previously read only top-level flags and omitted nested visibility.quickEntryEnabled / visibility.smartEntryEnabled fallback resolution.
